boundary: This record preserves the supplied source material, activation, and loading parameters and names six missing or conflicting admission inputs. It does not recover the unloaded anatomy, assign closure stiffness or inertial density, resolve venous/Robin supports, provide a time-resolved activation field, or qualify native anatomical stepping or subject calibration.

source_activation.calibration: all active values hand-tuned; all nonventricular structures passive
source_activation.source: S4 Table D; no silent substitution with prescribed chamber elastance

source_loading.afterload: separate three-element systemic and pulmonary Windkessel models
source_loading.boundary_conditions: omnidirectional springs on selected pulmonary vein/vena cava borders; spatially varying normal epicardial Robin support, maximum near apex and zero near base
source_loading.source: S4 Tables E-F and final paragraph; main article methods
source_loading.valve_resistance_note: S4 prose/table forward values zero for aortic/pulmonary valves were chosen for convergence and healthy-range ejection; large reverse resistances approximate blocked reverse flow. Canonical unit spelling here follows Table F resistance dimensions.

nonventricular.law: isochoric neo-Hookean with quadratic volumetric penalty
nonventricular.source: S4 equation 8 and Table C; average literature values, stiff valve layers are artificial constraints

ventricular.law: isochoric Guccione with logarithmic volumetric penalty
ventricular.source: S4 equations 3-7, Table B; same literature-derived values across the cohort

source_qualification.circulation_policy: coupling this wall to CVSim21 constitutes a new hybrid model; source Rodero outputs do not validate that hybrid
constructed_anatomy: atrial thickness2mm,RV thickness3.5mm,aortic thickness2mm,PA thickness3.5mm assigned from literature
left atrial appendage discarded in every case
valve layers constructed by dilation to approximately2mm thickness
blood pools,papillary muscles and trabeculae excluded from tetrahedral wall mesh
vein/valve closure structures support chamber-volume and boundary calculations; they are not functioning measured leaflets
source_qualification.mass_policy: blood pools excluded; no blood mass may be added/subtracted from mechanical tissue without an explicit wet-mass attribution owner
source_qualification.measured_anatomy: derived from end-diastolic CT of an asymptomatic participant; no cardiac conditions detected on follow-up after acute chest-pain presentation
source_qualification.source_output_evidence: simulation_output.csv reports source simulations, not measured patient pressure-volume calibration; all20 cases shared material/loading parameters; cases09 and10 did not converge

unresolved_gates.source_statement: case18 stress-free unloaded nodal configuration is not supplied
density and inertial-mass convention are not specified in the retained main article/S4
numerical Robin spring stiffness values/spatial function are not supplied in S4
main article says superior pulmonary vein anchors while S4 says right pulmonary veins; exact anchors require source resolution
source CARP solver inputs and time-resolved reference trajectory are not in the single-file case18 archive
source forward valve resistance zero is outside the currently shipped strictly positive resistive-edge admission; do not substitute epsilon silently
